spans.s:
Apūpa is the general word from the Rigveda^1 onwards for a
cake, which might be mixed with ghee (ghṛtavant),^2 or be
made of rice (vrīhi),^3 or of barley (yava).^4 In the Chāndogya
Upaniṣad^5 there is a difference of interpretation. Max Müller
renders it as ‘hive,’ Böhtlingk as ‘honeycomb,’ Little^6 as
‘cake.’
1) iii. 52, 7.
2) Rv. x. 45, 9.
3) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, ii. 2, 3, 12, 13.
4) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, iv. 2, 5, 19.
5) iii. 1, 1.
6) Grammatical Index, s.v.
